statement: ∀ (U : Set (GDVec n)) (ρ a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ ρ → Metric.ediam U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ → b - a ≤ ρ → Metric.ediam {z | ∃ x ∈ U, ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, z = GDPoint x t} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2 * ρ)
proof:
intro U ρ a b hρ hU hab
apply Metric.ediam_le_of_forall_dist_le
rintro _ ⟨x, hx, t, ht, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, u, hu, rfl⟩
have hxy : dist x y ≤ ρ := by
  have he : edist x y ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ := (Metric.edist_le_ediam_of_mem hx hy).trans hU
  rw [edist_dist, ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hρ] at he
  exact he
have htu : |t - u| ≤ ρ := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [ht.1, hu.2], by linarith [ht.2, hu.1]⟩
rw [h_T009.1]
have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = (2 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
apply (Real.sqrt_le_iff).mpr
constructor
· positivity
· rw [mul_pow, hs]
  have hx2 : dist x y ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 := by gcongr
  have ht2 : |t - u| ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 := by gcongr
  linarith

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GDVec n)),
  (∀ (m : ℕ) (A : Set (GDVec m)),
      0 ≤ dimH A ∧
        ∀ (s : ℝ),
          0 < s →
            GDMeasure s A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s) A ∧
              (ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH A → GDMeasure s A = ∞) ∧
                (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal s → GDMeasure s A = 0) ∧
                  (GDMeasure s A < ∞ → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧
                    (GDMeasure s A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧ (GDMeasure s A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ dimH A)) →
    Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
        0 ≤ dimH E ∧
          dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧
            dimH E < ∞ ∧ (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → GDContent s δ E < ∞) ∧ (n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ dimH E = 0) →
      (dimH GDInterval = 1 ∧
          (∀ (a : ℝ), 1 < a → GDMeasure a GDInterval = 0) ∧
            (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → 0 < δ → ENNReal.ofReal (δ ^ (s - 1)) ≤ GDContent s δ GDInterval) ∧
              ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s < 1 → GDMeasure s GDInterval = ∞) →
        (1 ≤ n → ∀ (q r ε : ℝ), dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q → 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → 0 < ε → GDPositiveCover E q r ε) →
          ((∀ (x y : GDVec n) (t u : ℝ), dist (GDPoint x t) (GDPoint y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
              ∀ (z : GDVec (n + 1)), ∃ x t, z = GDPoint x t) →
            ∀ (U : Set (GDVec n)) (ρ a b : ℝ),
              0 ≤ ρ →
                Metric.ediam U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ρ →
                  b - a ≤ ρ → Metric.ediam {z | ∃ x ∈ U, ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, z = GDPoint x t} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (√2 * ρ)
